Alright, I'll teach you the basics of handling an AT.
Not just the AT, you've gotta handle yourself well too.
Alright, Chirico. Try shooting the target in front of you.
Hey, what's wrong? Been away from ATs so long you got rusty?
More weapons is better, but they're useless if you can't use 'em
Switch weapons to suit the enemy type and the situation
A weapon with no ammo is no use. Go find a new one, quick
The Scopedog has an Arm Punch mechanism
In short, you punch the other guy's lights out!
There's a beat-up AT that'll make a good dummy. Try it!
On the battlefield, ATs are disposable. Sometimes switching is faster than babying one.
Take out the guy inside and you can steal his AT.
That's it, Chirico. Use whatever you can.
Watch your surroundings. Don't end up in the middle of the enemy without knowing it.
Last, how to use Mission Disks.
The disk has several programs set on it. Give 'em a try.
Use the Mission Disk when the timing lets you activate it, got it?
That's the end of the AT basics.
A Real Battle?! I never set up a match like that!
Whoa! Old man Gotho sure did something bold!
This killing intent... Could it be...
Once I'm paid, I'm done here!
Stay here and no number of lives would be enough!
They mean to drive us out...
Only a few know this, but a subway line runs beside the machine room.
Nwah! You've done it now, haven't you?!
Let's hurry... Borough should be deep inside the palace
Can't get through here. Let's find another way?
An AT's attack could probably break it...
Couldn't an AT's attack break that?
I don't want to see Ypsilon right now.
Borough and the others are probably way in the back.
Going room by room will take forever.
You can't win in a straight fight.
Don't forget... we're both fighting in order to live...
Wait in the control room. Here I go!
There's no point in coming after me anymore...
Even if you don't kill us, we'll die anyway.
You don't understand! I am a being beyond humanity!
Still, it'd be a waste to kill a man who can match a PS...
You don't realize what it means that you were made into a PS.
I live only to win! That's all!
Chirico is an ordinary human! He doesn't need Jijirium!
Jijirium is not an absolute requirement!
How did he handle that huge army...
I see how firm your will is...
Heh heh heh... That's 100mm armor! That won't even scratch it!
Or are you only good at touching?
Hey, Chirico! We're out of time!
This is a cakewalk for you, right, Chirico?
Waah! We're gonna get killed! Chiricooo!
Chiricooo! We can't move like this! Take those guys out!
We can't win like this... Stealing an AT is the only way...
We hold this position until the boat is fixed! Understood?!
It wasn't just an aptitude test. They called it cannibalism
What? But isn't this your first time on Sunsa...?
The Red Shoulder was disbanded when the war ended
Hmph... If there are any Red Shoulder ghosts... it might be us
Bad timing... We always seem to meet when things are busy...
Heh... Don't worry. I won't burden you any more than needed.
Fyana's in my right arm... I can't afford to take hits
They're holding us hostage, so I have no choice but to come after you!
Hey, Chirico! Looks like they're getting serious
Chirico! Looks like they've gotten serious, too
Chirico, be careful! I have a bad feeling...
Damn, I got hit... and looks like the army's wiped out too
Yeah, I'm talking, aren't I... But I'm done babysitting you
Let's get to the shallows over there... I can treat your wounds
Thanks... It's been years since anyone worried about me...
That whole army was wiped out, yet he survived... The test was worth it
Chirico, they must be hiding somewhere, be careful
Dirty cheats! Wasn't this one-on-one?! That's not the deal!
Chirico, you don't have to play their game. Let's scram!
No good, they're here too! Isn't there anywhere else to hide?!
Geez, you sure keep me busy
Hanging around Chirico, no number of lives would be enough!
I'd love to save Chirico, but I'm not obliged to bet my life on it!
Ah, there's too much danger. I can't see this going smoothly...
